operation_details.item: The user's design work is led by an external contractor.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey, just reviewing the team structure for the investor update. Engineering is on me, growth is with the growth lead, and design is handled by an outside contractor — that's still correct, right?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Yep, that matches the org chart. Engineering under you, growth under the growth lead, and design is external. Looks consistent.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Good. I want to make sure we don't overstate internal capacity when we say 'team leadership' — the org chart lists leadership roles clearly, so we're fine.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Absolutely. The org chart is the source of truth for leadership roles. So you're not claiming design as in-house, which is good.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. The contractor does good work, but I like being transparent about who leads what. Engineering and growth are internal leads, design is outsourced.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. I'll keep that framing in mind for any future documentation. Anything else on the update?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: No, that's it. Thanks for confirming.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Anytime. Let me know if you want to review the org chart or the update draft.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that design is led by an external contractor, while keeping the engineering and growth leads and the org chart.
